utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do we have enough volunteers for the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, volunteers? I think Rey said he'd be there with gloves... but I can't quite remember who else. Did you sign up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: No, I've been busy organizing the tool inventory. What if we put a quick sign-up sheet at the center's front desk?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've heard a bit about the repair drive from Vik—what do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell! I’ve got it confirmed for Saturday at 9 AM at the community center—could you maybe help with greeting folks or sorting items?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I can help with greeting folks—just point me to where I need to stand, and I'll be there at 9!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hear your concern about genuine buy-in, but without a deadline we'll never know who's truly committed. Friday gives us a clear picture and avoids assumptions.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that's enough time? I mean, people have busy schedules...

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We can adjust if needed, but if we push it too far out, folks will forget or put it off—then we're back to square one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've got the route almost finalized—just need a few more pinpoints to make sure we cover every corner efficiently.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Opal—did I miss anything about the route for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not at all, Dane—I've got most stops plotted, but could you suggest any specific addresses you think need a visit? I want to make sure we don't miss anyone.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Eli, have you heard about the repair drive tomorrow? I'm trying to pin down where it'll stop next.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Faye, the repair drive is Saturday at 9 AM at the community center, not tomorrow. Check the flyer on the board—it's all there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Ah, thanks Eli—I must've mixed up the days. I'll swing by and check that flyer before I start rounding up folks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! You coming to the repair drive tomorrow? We're meeting at the community center at 10 to fix stuff up—bring your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You bet, Jules! I've got my toolbox ready and I'll be there at 10 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Sam! Glad to have you on board—it's going to be a great day of fixing and chatting!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah, just to confirm, Mara said 10am at Leo's garage — you're all set!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, 10am at Leo's — got it. Thanks for the reminder, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem, Noah! Don't forget to bring your tools—we'll have plenty to fix up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, Leo's garage, Saturday 10am—I'll dig up that toaster. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Cool, see you then. I'll save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, appreciate that. I'll try not to be late this time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, good thinking about safety gear! I'll see if the center can provide gloves and goggles, but it's wise to bring your own just in case.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'll bring extra gloves just in case. Can't have too many, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Cleo! Your foresight is much appreciated. I'll check with the center about goggles too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Have you heard about the repair drive this weekend, Mara? I'm finally taking my old lawnmower over—Sam's even offered to help me haul it!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh that's perfect, Tess! We've got a whole station set up for small engines and appliances, and Sam's a whiz with that kind of stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I know, right? I'm so relieved—that lawnmower's been sitting in my shed for years, and it's about time it got some love!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive! We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM tomorrow to fix up the Smiths' fence. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I'll be there. Still trying to see what tools I can spare without needing them myself.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you then! I'm bringing my old toaster too, just in case someone can fix it while we work on the fence.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll be at the community center Saturday around 10 with extra gloves if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I'll bring my squeaky lawn mower—hope you're ready for a challenge!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: A lawn mower, huh? I'll bring my biggest wrench—see you at 10.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm so excited about the repair drive this weekend! I'm finally bringing my old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh great, Tess! I'm glad you're bringing your lawnmower. Need a hand carrying it over to the community center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That'd be wonderful, Ira! I was just thinking I might need an extra pair of arms to get it down the porch steps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal, glad you're here. I'm hoping to gather a few more tools for the drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's great, Uli! Do you have any specific addresses where you think the drive should stop?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Well, I think folks are planning to bring their stuff to Rosa's yard, so that's the main spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! Just a heads-up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Wait, Rosa, I thought it was at Leo's garage at 10am? Are you sure about the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I see the confusion! It was never at Leo's garage — we moved it from the front porch to the community center on Sunday. Would you like me to send you the new time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara, have you heard anything about the repair drive this weekend? I just got word from Vik and am curious to learn more.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh hey Nell! Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10am. We're fixing up bikes and small appliances—bring anything you need repaired!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great! I have a wobbly table leg I've been meaning to fix—can I just show up with it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, so it's this Saturday at Leo's garage, right? 10am?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Bo, actually I think it's tomorrow at the community center for the Smiths' fence—I just heard from Vik.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, so it's not at Leo's garage? I'm getting totally lost on where we're supposed to be.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... remind me what it's for again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday at Leo's garage—everyone's bringing broken stuff to fix together, and it's going to be a great community event!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Leo's garage! I think I have a busted lamp I've been meaning to bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Gus, I've got the tools sorted for Sunday—hammers, screwdrivers, and extra gloves. Need me to add anything to the list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That sounds great, Cleo! One thing we might need is a voltage tester for checking electronics safely.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good thinking, Gus! I'll grab one from my toolbox and add it to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey, glad you're here! We're all set up and ready to start fixes—what brings you in today?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just wanted to make sure I brought those extra pairs of gloves I promised—and my own toolkit, in case we need more than what's here.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great timing, Rey! Those gloves will come in handy, and I bet we'll put that toolkit to good use before the day's over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, do you have a moment to help me finalize the repair drive stops? Opal's got the addresses, but I need a hand sorting the timing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, let's run through the schedule quick. Got the list of stops?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I've got Opal's addresses right here—can we start with the community center at 10, since Jules already confirmed that one?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive! We're meeting at the community center at 10 AM tomorrow to fix up the Smiths' fence. Don't forget your toolbox!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was Saturday at 9 AM at the community center—are we talking about the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, is it Saturday? I might be mixing things up—there's just so many repair events! But I know the Smiths' fence definitely needs fixing, so bring your tools whenever we figure out the right time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Kira, I heard there's a repair drive this weekend? Or is it next weekend? I can't remember.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure that's really needed around here?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I'm not totally sure—Mara mentioned it, and she seemed pretty certain about it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey, is the repair drive still set for Saturday? And did you check with Rey about the mowers?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'll swing by Rey's place this afternoon and ask about the mowers—should have an answer for you soon!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Jules. Let me know what he says.
